post.author: tripleyothreat
post.title: DAE think 2007-2012 was the peak of gaming?
post.body:
Assassin's Creed, Battlefield, Call of Duty, everything seems to have peaked then,

Not sure if it's nostalgia or this is really true

Everything was so good. I distinctly remember Battlefield Bad Company 2. It was one of the first with world destruction, you could rocket any walls and they would break. It was a pretty epic game engine and one of the first that did it really well.

Call of Duty and the 360 world was in its peak.

Games had no micro transactions.

So much more, I could keep going
